sources: https://www.volusia.org/file/6145/Camp-Sites.pdf (the page's 'Camp Site Dimensions' link, a scanned table read as an image)

hookups.source: https://www.volusia.org/file/6145/Camp-Sites.pdf ('RV Camp Sites have 20, 30 and 50 amp outlets. Tent Camp Site have 20 amp outlets only.'; a 'Water Loc.' for every one of the 25 sites) + the park page ('Camping: Fees include power'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 25 campsites: 15 RV sites recommended for RVs of 25 ft to '35'+' (sites 9, 10, 23 and 24 take 35 ft or more; 20 is 35 ft), and 10 tent sites. The county's recommended RV size allows for obstacles and maneuvering into the site.

sites.source: https://www.volusia.org/file/6145/Camp-Sites.pdf (Camp Site Dimensions for Lake Monroe Park: sites 1-25 with L, W, 'RV Size' and 'Tent or RV'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Call the park, 386-736-5953, Monday-Friday 8:30 am-4:30 pm. County code limits camping to 7 consecutive days and 30 days a calendar year. The park is open sunrise to sunset.

booking.source: https://www.volusia.org/services/community-services/parks-recreation-and-culture/parks-and-trails/park-facilities-and-locations/ecological-nature-parks/lake-monroe-park.stml ('To reserve recreational facilities, please call 386-736-5953 Monday through Friday 8:30 am - 4:30 pm'; 'Reservations: Per Ch.82 of the Volusia County Code the length of stay for authorized camping shall be no greater than seven (7) consecutive days or thirty (30) total days per calender year.'), read 2026-10-21

note: Volusia County park on Lake Monroe / St. Johns River. --Claude
